credit: Sky from a 360° suburban panorama supplied by Universal Frames; street, homes and trees are modeled (trees baked from ez-tree, MIT, Daniel Greenheck; bark textures Poly Haven / TextureCan CC0).
about: mode "neighborhood" draws a modeled street, homes and trees around the house under this photographed sky (image: equirectangular sky, 4096 x 2048; mobileImage 2048 x 1024). rotation turns the sky in degrees. Remove mode to project a full 360-degree photo instead (see scripts/backdrop/README.md).
